steps.en: Clone the app, install deps, start the local server
steps.zh: 克隆应用、装依赖、本地起服务

steps.en: Scans your PATH and surfaces every signed-in agent CLI it recognizes
steps.zh: 扫描 PATH，列出它识别出的、你已登录的 agent CLI

steps.en: Paste Markdown/CSV/JSON, pick a skill template, hit ⌘+Enter
steps.zh: 粘进 Markdown/CSV/JSON，挑一个模板，按 ⌘+Enter

steps.en: Spawns your CLI and streams single-file HTML into a sandboxed iframe preview
steps.zh: spawn 你的 CLI，把单文件 HTML 流式渲进沙箱 iframe

steps.en: One-click export: juice-inlined CSS into WeChat, 2× PNG into the tweet composer
steps.zh: 一键导出：内联 CSS 粘进微信，2× PNG 发推

value.en: A designed, ship-ready single-file HTML — no hand-written CSS, no API key, content stays on your machine
value.zh: 排版即交付的单文件 HTML——不手写 CSS、不配 API key、内容不出本机

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09 (Quickstart): git clone https://github.com/nexu-io/html-anything; pnpm install; pnpm -F @html-anything/next dev; 'top bar auto-detects whichever coding-agent CLI you already have signed in → pick a template → paste content → ⌘+Enter'
README.md main @ 2026-09 (Architecture): 'On boot the browser calls /api/agents … one adapter per CLI in next/src/lib/agents/argv.ts'; POST /api/convert SSE spawn
